design.constraint_geometry: Separate spectral-norm balls and nonnegative factors.
design.full_batch: SFRAMES with all training views and separately tuned gamma0. The decay exponents and smoothing scale are shared.
design.inference: Fresh slices from separated acquisition batches of two sample mixes. Slices in a mix share a sample tube; summarize paired effects descriptively.
design.timing: Optimizer time only, four concurrent single-threaded physical-core workers.
design.selection: No evaluation slice, held-out view, or reference image enters rate selection.

comparison.direction: Minibatch SFRAMES minus comparator. Negative favors SFRAMES.
comparison.pairing: Same slice and number of training views with shared calibration. Stochastic arms pair by oracle seed. Each deterministic arm is run once per slice and training size and serves as a shared reference.
comparison.within_budget: Last completed-run probe at or below the cap, without interpolation.
comparison.endpoint: Last probe. Different methods may overshoot the nominal stopping budget.
comparison.slice_estimate: Median paired difference across available seeds within each slice.
comparison.summary_estimate: Median of slice medians at each training-view count.
comparison.mixes: Slices within a material mix may be correlated. Overall and within-mix estimates are descriptive summaries.
comparison.percentages: Percent difference uses the paired comparator value as the denominator. Zero denominators are excluded from percent summaries.

selection.rule: Smallest median repaired training loss relative to the common initial loss, at the last iterate within 8640 forward views, across both slices and view counts.
